solutions.title: Stack matching
solutions.notes: Classic stack — push opens, match closes
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Stack of expected closers (or openings). On close, pop and verify match; empty stack at end.

**Why preferred:** Canonical stack interview pattern with explicit empty-stack / mismatch guards.

solutions.title: Stack of opening brackets
solutions.notes: Stack of openings + map — same idea
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Push openings from a map; on a closer, pop and check it maps to that closer; require empty stack at end.

**vs recommended:** Essentially the same algorithm. Tighten with `!==`, and treat `pop()` on an empty stack as invalid (extra closing bracket).
